chapterInfo.content:
40
Aseda ne adesrɛ mpaebɔ
Wɔde ma awonkyerɛfoɔ. Dawid dwom.
1Twɛn na metwɛnee AWURADE,
na ɔyɛɛ aso maa me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.
2Na ɔyii me firii ɔsɛeɛ amena mu,
firii atɛkyɛ mu,
na ɔde me nan sii ɔbotan so,
ɔmaa m’anammɔn tintimii.
3 # Dwom 33.3 Na ɔde dwom foforɔ ahyɛ m’anomu,
yɛn Nyankopɔn ayeyie.
Nnipa bebree bɛhunu asuro,
na wɔabata AWURADE ho.
4Nhyira ne onipa a
ɔde n’ani ato AWURADE soɔ,
na ɔnnane n’ani nkyerɛ ahantanfoɔ
ne wɔn a wɔmane di atorɔ.
5 # Dwom 139.17-18 AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn,
w’anwanwadeɛ ne w’adwene, woama no adɔɔso ama yɛn,
wɔrentumi mfa biribiara nto wo ho;
anka mɛka na makasa ho,
ɛdɔɔso sene sɛ wɔbɛtumi akan.
6 # Dwom 51.16; Heb 10.5-10; Yes 50.5 Wompɛ afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ,
woasiesie aso de ama me,
wommisa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ
ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.
7Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mereba,
wɔatwerɛ me ho asɛm nwoma mmobɔeɛ no mu.
8Deɛ mepɛ ne sɛ mɛyɛ deɛ wo, me Nyankopɔn, wopɛ,
na wo mmara wɔ m’akomam.
9 # Dwom 22.22, 25 Maka tenenee ho asɛmpa
asafo kɛseɛ mu,
hwɛ, meremmua m’ano,
AWURADE, wonim.
10Mankora wo tenenee m’akomam,
maka wo nokorɛ ne wo nkwagyeɛ,
mansi w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ so
asafo kɛseɛ mu.
11Wo, AWURADE, worensi me
wo mmɔborɔhunu so,
w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ
bɛbɔ me ho ban daa.
12Na bɔne a wɔnnim ano
atwa me ho ahyia,
m’amumuyɛ asɔ me mu
a ɛmma menhunu adeɛ bio,
ɛdɔɔso sene me tiri so nwi,
na m’akoma agya me.
13AWURADE, ma no nyɛ wo fɛ sɛ wobɛgye me,
AWURADE, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me!
14 # Dwom 6.10 Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra
asɛe no no ani nwu,
na wɔn anim ngu ase,
ma wɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔne nsane wɔn akyi, na wɔnnane ahohorafoɔ.
15 # Dwom 35.21, 25 Wɔn a wɔse me sɛ: Wiɛ, wiɛ no,
ma wɔn ho nnwiri wɔn, wɔn aniwuo akatua so.
16Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ woɔ nyinaa
nni ahurisie, na wɔn ani nnye wo ho;
ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagyeɛ nka daa sɛ:
Wɔnkamfo AWURADE kɛseyɛ.
17 # Dwom 109.22 Na me deɛ, meyɛ mmɔbɔ na meyɛ ohiani deɛ,
nanso AWURADE dwene me ho.
Wone me boafoɔ ne me gyefoɔ, me Nyankopɔn,
ntwentwɛn wo nan ase!

Twɛn na metwɛnee AWURADE,
na ɔyɛɛ aso maa me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.
Na ɔyii me firii ɔsɛeɛ amena mu,
firii atɛkyɛ mu,
na ɔde me nan sii ɔbotan so,
ɔmaa m’anammɔn tintimii.
Na ɔde dwom foforɔ ahyɛ m’anomu,
yɛn Nyankopɔn ayeyie.
Nnipa bebree bɛhunu asuro,
na wɔabata AWURADE ho.
Nhyira ne onipa a
ɔde n’ani ato AWURADE soɔ,
na ɔnnane n’ani nkyerɛ ahantanfoɔ
ne wɔn a wɔmane di atorɔ.
AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn,
w’anwanwadeɛ ne w’adwene, woama no adɔɔso ama yɛn,
wɔrentumi mfa biribiara nto wo ho;
anka mɛka na makasa ho,
ɛdɔɔso sene sɛ wɔbɛtumi akan.
Wompɛ afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ,
woasiesie aso de ama me,

ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.
Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mereba,
wɔatwerɛ me ho asɛm nwoma mmobɔeɛ no mu.
Deɛ mepɛ ne sɛ mɛyɛ deɛ wo, me Nyankopɔn, wopɛ,
na wo mmara wɔ m’akomam.
Maka tenenee ho asɛmpa
asafo kɛseɛ mu,
hwɛ, meremmua m’ano,
AWURADE, wonim.
Mankora wo tenenee m’akomam,
maka wo nokorɛ ne wo nkwagyeɛ,
mansi w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ so
asafo kɛseɛ mu.
Wo, AWURADE, worensi me
wo mmɔborɔhunu so,
w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ
bɛbɔ me ho ban daa.
Na bɔne a wɔnnim ano
atwa me ho ahyia,
m’amumuyɛ asɔ me mu
a ɛmma menhunu adeɛ bio,
ɛdɔɔso sene me tiri so nwi,
na m’akoma agya me.
AWURADE, ma no nyɛ wo fɛ sɛ wobɛgye me,
AWURADE, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me!
Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra
asɛe no no ani nwu,
na wɔn anim ngu ase,
ma wɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔne nsane wɔn akyi, na wɔnnane ahohorafoɔ.
Wɔn a wɔse me sɛ: Wiɛ, wiɛ no,
ma wɔn ho nnwiri wɔn, wɔn aniwuo akatua so.
Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ woɔ nyinaa
nni ahurisie, na wɔn ani nnye wo ho;
ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagyeɛ nka daa sɛ:
Wɔnkamfo AWURADE kɛseyɛ.
Na me deɛ, meyɛ mmɔbɔ na meyɛ ohiani deɛ,
nanso AWURADE dwene me ho.
Wone me boafoɔ ne me gyefoɔ, me Nyankopɔn,
ntwentwɛn wo nan ase!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
